usage: The word '侄女' refers to your brother's daughter.
'侄女' is used to specify a female child related through your brother, not your sister.
It can be used as a subject or an object in a sentence.
You can use '我嘅侄女' to say 'my brother's daughter'.
It is common to use '侄女' when talking about family members during gatherings.
